review.verdict: No known blocking correctness defect remains in the reviewed experimental software scope. The lead reports that the final isolated delivery tree passed the required local checks, build and declared simulation benchmark; it is ready for PR review. The evidence does not justify a perfect score in every dimension, commercial-game parity, or physical motion certification.

ratings.dimension: Lane controls, jump/roll and collision correctness
ratings.evidence: Absolute lanes, hysteresis, causal source-time consumption, jump rearming, held duck, continuous train occupancy and coin removal are covered by focused behavior tests and code review.

Extra participants freeze the entire timeline; identity/space changes require a fresh run. Identity loss takes priority when another person is detected simultaneously, so clearing the extra-person condition cannot restore an uncertain score owner. Confirmed standing evidence gates admission and recovery. Transport tests use synthetic people; physical detection reliability remains unverified.

Distinct rail/gold worlds and three skins, readable hurdle/overhead/train silhouettes, bounded tucked roll and visible jump. Geometry tests verify train contact, hurdle clearance and roll bounds. Art and animation remain a simple original low-poly treatment.
Accepted live-server screenshot shows readable HUD backplates, visible in-stage Pause, controls, settings and an unobstructed game scene. Start, pause, results and recovery have explanatory copy.

The final 390x844 viewport shows the runner, in-stage Pause and all five touch actions together. The paused 320px view reflows legibly. The avatar is relatively small on mobile, and accessibility testing is bounded rather than a full compliance audit.

Meaningful unit, DOM, synthetic transport, geometry, determinism and multi-rate simulation evidence. The lead owns final repository/build/CI results; unit tests do not replace hardware or browser performance measurements.

ratings.dimension: Gameplay and presentation parity with reference footage
